name: DHT Analyzer EN
author: siroyiryuu
description: Decodes the DHT11 / DHT12 / DHT22(AM2302) single-wire temperature & humidity protocol and shows 'RH 33.0% / T 28.0 C' bubbles on the waveform. Uses the built-in 'Simple Parallel' analyzer as an edge sampler (Clock = the DHT data line, Clock Edge = Falling, D0 = the same line) and reconstructs pulse widths from the time between adjacent falling edges. English build of the DHT Analyzer extension.
